scheme_name: PM-AJAY: GIA Comprehensive Skill Development Training Component
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_audience: Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals and marginalized rural/urban youth seeking formal NSQF skilling
financial_grant: 100% Free NSQF Skilling Course + Assessment & Certification Fee fully funded by MoSJE
stipend_amount: ₹1,500/month training conveyance allowance with free residential boarding & food
loan_subsidy: Direct linkage to Special Central Assistance (SCA) subsidy upon course completion
toolkit_support: Free modern trade toolkit provided upon course graduation
key_benefits: 100% Free NSQF Skilling + ₹1,500/month Stipend + Free Hostel + Free Trade Toolkit + Placement Linkage

scheme_name: PM-AJAY: GIA Livelihood Toolkit & Machinery Capital Grant
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_audience: Skilled SC artisans, technicians, and nano-entrepreneurs initiating self-employment enterprises
financial_grant: Non-repayable Capital/Toolkit Grant up to ₹50,000 for acquiring modern trade machinery & equipment
stipend_amount: Free orientation & equipment safety training provided
loan_subsidy: Can be combined with Bank loan / MUDRA loan for higher capital investments
toolkit_support: Direct procurement of industry-grade sewing machines, carpentry kits, solar tools, mechanic sets, or salon equipment
key_benefits: Up to ₹50,000 Capital Subsidy for purchasing tools & machinery with zero debt obligation

scheme_name: PM-AJAY: Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) Certification & Cash Award
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment & MSDE Convergence
target_audience: Experienced informal SC workers and artisans with at least 1-3 years of uncertified trade experience
financial_grant: 100% free NSQF competency assessment + ₹500 DBT cash reward on successful certification
stipend_amount: Wage compensation of ₹500/day during the 12-hour orientation assessment
loan_subsidy: Priority credit eligibility under NSFDC and MUDRA upon receiving NSQF Certificate
toolkit_support: Trade safety PPE kit and NSQF Certificate with QR code
key_benefits: Official Government NSQF Skill Certificate + ₹500 Cash Reward + 3-Year Free Accidental Insurance (₹2 Lakh) + Wage compensation

scheme_name: PM-AJAY: Special Central Assistance (SCA) Credit Subsidy & Bank Linkage
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_audience: SC individuals and micro-enterprises requiring project finance and term loans for business setup
financial_grant: Direct back-ended capital subsidy up to ₹50,000 or 50% of the project cost (whichever is lower)
loan_subsidy: Bank loan linkage with subsidized interest rate via State SC Development Corporations (SDCs)
toolkit_support: Financing covers 100% of working capital, raw materials, and enterprise machinery
key_benefits: Up to ₹50,000 Government Subsidy + Priority Institutional Credit Linkage for setting up shops and workshops

scheme_name: PM-AJAY: Common Facility Centre (CFC) Artisan Tool-Bank Access
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_audience: Artisans, craftspersons, leather workers, and garment makers in SC-concentrated village clusters
financial_grant: 100% Free shared access to high-end industrial machinery, laser cutters, testing labs, and design studios
stipend_amount: Free technical demo sessions on computerized machinery
loan_subsidy: Zero capital investment required by the artisan to access expensive industrial machinery
toolkit_support: Access to heavy equipment, high-speed overlock stitching machines, woodworking lathes, and battery analyzers
key_benefits: Free access to industrial-grade machinery in village clusters + Bulk raw material purchasing at subsidized rates

scheme_name: PM-AJAY: Income Generating Projects (IGP) for SC Self-Help Groups (SHGs)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_audience: SC Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and producer collectives taking up group livelihoods
financial_grant: Group project grant up to ₹5,00,000 per SHG for community processing, tailoring, dairy, or handloom units
stipend_amount: Reimbursement of bookkeeping and group training expenses
loan_subsidy: Revolving fund and interest subvention through NRLM / Aajeevika convergence
toolkit_support: Bulk processing equipment, group sewing workstations, and solar dryer installations
key_benefits: Up to ₹5,00,000 Grant per SHG + Group Livelihood Setup + Direct Market Linkages with SARAS Fairs

scheme_name: PM-AJAY: Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana (Model Village Livelihood Convergence)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_audience: Residents of 50%+ SC population villages selected under Adarsh Gram component
financial_grant: Comprehensive community livelihood grant of ₹21 Lakh per village for gap filling in skill infrastructure
stipend_amount: Local livelihood facilitator support and on-site training sessions in village community centers
loan_subsidy: Special financial inclusion camps in the village for zero-balance Mudra / KCC accounts
toolkit_support: Village-level tool rental banks and agricultural equipment custom hiring centers
key_benefits: Skill centers built directly inside the village + Guaranteed last-mile doorstep registration

scheme_name: PM-AJAY: Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana (Residential Skilling Hostel Facility)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_audience: SC trainees and students undergoing long-term NSQF residential skilling away from home
financial_grant: 100% Centrally funded free boarding, secure lodging, Wi-Fi access, and nutrition
stipend_amount: Monthly incidental allowance of ₹1,000 during the residential training tenure
loan_subsidy: Not applicable (100% Free Government Residential Facility)
toolkit_support: Study kits, reference manuals, and digital tablet access inside the hostel library
key_benefits: Completely Free Accommodation & Meals at accredited training complexes for trainees from remote villages

scheme_name: PM Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman Yojana (Convergence with PM-AJAY)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
target_audience: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in 18 designated family trades
financial_grant: ₹15,000 digital e-voucher for modern toolkit purchase
stipend_amount: ₹500 per day stipend during 5-7 days basic skilling / 15 days advanced training
loan_subsidy: Collateral-free credit support up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest rate (Tranche 1: ₹1 Lakh, Tranche 2: ₹2 Lakh)
toolkit_support: Brand-new certified digital tool voucher worth ₹15,000
key_benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID + ₹15,000 Toolkit E-Voucher + ₹500/day Stipend + Collateral-Free 5% Loan

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (Skill India Digital Convergence)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
target_audience: Unemployed youth, school/college dropouts seeking industry-ready skill certifications
financial_grant: 100% course fee subsidy sponsored by NSDC under PM-AJAY skilling convergence
stipend_amount: ₹500 travel allowance per exam module + ₹2 Lakh accident insurance coverage
loan_subsidy: Eligible for Skill Loan Scheme up to ₹1,50,000 at low interest
toolkit_support: Standard course training manual & digital learning materials on Skill India Digital Hub
key_benefits: Government NSQF Certification + DigiLocker integration + Rozgar Mela Placement Support

scheme_name: NSFDC Term Loan & Micro-Credit Scheme for Scheduled Castes
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_audience: Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals with family income up to ₹3.00 Lakh per annum
financial_grant: Up to ₹10,000 capital subsidy converged with state SC corporations
loan_subsidy: Term loans up to ₹50 Lakh for self-employment enterprises at concessional 4% to 6% interest rate
toolkit_support: Finances 90% cost of all plant, tools, commercial vehicles, and equipment
key_benefits: Ultra-low 4-6% interest rate loans + Flexible 5 to 10 year repayment terms + Special SC women rebate

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_audience: Safai Karamcharis, manual scavengers, waste pickers, and their dependent family members
financial_grant: One-time cash assistance of ₹40,000 + Up to ₹5 Lakh capital subsidy for sanitation enterprises
stipend_amount: ₹3,000 per month stipend during 2-6 months NSQF skill development training
loan_subsidy: Concessional loans up to ₹15 Lakh for mechanized sanitation equipment at 4% interest
toolkit_support: Full mechanized protective cleaning kit and safety PPE gear provided free
key_benefits: ₹40,000 Immediate Cash Assistance + Free NSQF Skilling + ₹3,000/mo Stipend + Mechanized equipment subsidy

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Converged with PM-AJAY Livelihoods)
target_audience: Scheduled Caste (SC) and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield manufacturing/service units
financial_grant: Margin money convergence with state incentive policies
stipend_amount: Handholding support via Lead District Managers (LDMs) and SIDBI
loan_subsidy: Priority bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore with composite loan structure
toolkit_support: Finances complete plant, machinery, industrial tools, and working capital
key_benefits: Institutional bank lending between ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore for SC greenfield businesses

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana — Shishu Category (Trade Tool & Working Capital)
target_audience: Micro-entrepreneurs, self-employed artisans, shop owners, and trade technicians starting out
financial_grant: Zero collateral or third-party guarantor required
loan_subsidy: Collateral-free business loan up to ₹50,000 at affordable institutional bank interest
toolkit_support: Loan proceeds can be directly utilized for toolkits, sewing machines, diagnostic kits, and inventory
key_benefits: Instant Working Capital up to ₹50,000 + Mudra RuPay Debit Card for digital purchase of supplies

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana — Kishore Category (Enterprise Expansion)
target_audience: Existing skilled artisans and small business owners expanding their workshop or enterprise
financial_grant: Zero collateral required for loans up to ₹5 Lakhs
toolkit_support: Asset financing for industrial sewing machines, automotive lifts, welding rigs, and IT hardware
key_benefits: Business expansion capital up to ₹5,00,000 + flexible 3 to 5 year repayment terms
